MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The wired headphones were a partial match because I previously bought a headset with a microphone, so wired listening and calling accessories are relevant to me.",
    "Practical accessories fit part of my history, but none of these felt like a strong next purchase without a specific need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Canon remote and battery assume I own a compatible camera; my tablet mount does not establish that.",
    "Streaming sticks and a smart speaker do not solve the computer connection needs reflected in my USB, Ethernet, and display accessories.",
    "A tablet mount does not mean I need another tablet, and my history gives me no current reason to buy a drive case, memory card, or gadget bag.",
    "Even the headphones would be easy to skip because an earlier headset purchase does not mean I need a replacement now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in particular electronic accessories seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any electronic device.",
    "Buying an accessory seems to have been treated as a reason to buy related equipment, even when ownership and compatibility are unclear."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchase was a USB-to-Ethernet adapter, which points more directly toward practical computer connectivity than entertainment devices.",
    "The connections and devices an accessory supports matter more to me than its broad resemblance to something I bought before.",
    "My purchases are spread far apart, and I rarely act without a concrete need; a past purchase alone is not enough to make another one relevant."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in electronics accessories but missed the specific connectivity needs and compatibility that make an item useful to me."
}
